Body.Content:
What and why

We are introducing an updated search experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for users with a Microsoft 365 license who do not have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. The updated experience provides modern search controls to help users find, refine, and navigate search results more easily.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late November 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-December 2026.
  • Deferred Release (Worldwide): Rollout will begin in late December 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-January 2027.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Users with a Microsoft 365 license who do not have a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot app

What will happen

  • The updated search experience will be enabled by default for users in Standard release tenants.
  • Users can return to the classic search experience by using the toggle on the search results page.

  • With the updated search experience, users can continue to find files using keywords, use modern search controls to refine and navigate results, and search supported connected third-party content when their organization has configured connected sources.
  • Search results will continue to display only content that users have permission to access.

Action required and recommendations

We recommend that you:

  • Inform users and your help desk about the updated interface and how it differs from the classic search experience.
  • Explain how users can return to the classic search experience using the toggle on the search results page.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
